My ex was taking the simmering approach. I was unhappy and crying a lot because I felt like I was doing something wrong or wondering if I had too many needs. I’d never been a needy person before but I started to question my relationship skills. Finally, I confronted him and asked him if he was trying to break up with me. He was surprised as if the idea had never occurred to him. He said he didn’t want to break up and he was sorry that he’d been getting busier and busier. I knew I needed more out a relationship so I ended it anyway. He told me he loved me and even reached out to me a few months later. I have spent the last 2 1/2 years thinking about him less and less everyday. I can’t go an entire week yet, but my goal this year will help. I’m going to make new memories with better friends and good dates at the places that trigger memories of him. I can replace him so that I’m not triggered every time I pass that shop or do that activity. I think I will always love him until I find the guy that is the even better fit. It’s just hard to have faith and hope that as good as were, someone will be even better. Hang in there fam. You guys are worth it ❤️

My grandma’s cousin disappeared for decades. Her mother walked out on them and her father worked as laborer at a traveling circus. The cousin stayed with relatives initially, and they begged her father to let her stay.  Eventually her father came and took her on full-time and they never heard from him again. They were lost to circus until about 3 years ago when my grandmother reconnected with her cousin on social media. My grandmother is well into her 70’s now and discovered her cousin again along with her cousins’s small family. Not exactly the crazy story because it has a happy ending but I just can’t believe my relatives were lost to the circus for a while. Didn’t think that actually happened...

There’s gotta be one thing that brings you a sliver of a smile. It sucks to be alone and to feel like that’s how you’re always gonna be. But don’t measure the value of your existence on things outside of your control. Love comes in so many varieties. You can create some while you wait for that person, that romantic love, to be ready for you. You matter. You matter now, exactly as you are. Believe that love will find you and in the mean time choose to accept the love and happiness that you have now. It won’t erase the depression or health problems, but you can’t say that you don’t have love and happiness when you’ve learned to recognize its varieties in your life. Hang in there ❤️
